name: Maximum Projected Teaching Set Size of Singletons
proof: Fix a target singleton in a subfamily of $m$ singleton concepts on the original domain. Project onto the $m-1$ coordinates of its competitors. The target becomes the empty trace, and each competitor becomes a different singleton trace; teaching the target requires all $m-1$ negative coordinates. Conversely, in any projection there are at most $m-1$ other distinct traces. Choose one coordinate of disagreement with each such trace to teach the target using at most $m-1$ observations. Thus every target has worst projected teaching-set size exactly $m-1$, including zero at $m=1$. Applying this to the full class with $m=n$ and maximizing over its targets gives $n-1$.
